records.unit: explicit SI fields; atoms per pseudo-molecule
records.operating_boundary: Single assigned enthalpy at 298.15 K; no continuous liquid state equation
records.model_use: C17 public fixed-RP1 adapter with O2(L)90.170 K and nine neutral gas products; not a flight input
records.notes: Source lines 15775-15777. C1H1.95 is an elemental bookkeeping unit, not identification of a Chinese fuel batch.

product_sets.expanded: CEA default C/H/O neutral gas and allowed condensed products; no ions keyword

c_contract.entry: rp_kerosene_anchor_inlet -> rp_kerosene_equilibrium_hp_anchor -> internal HP; CLI reuses fixed-area frozen nozzle
c_contract.failure: Preserve numeric_error at O/F=0.5; never emit temperature/nozzle success fields for failed point
c_contract.public_adapter: Pinned dataset/fuel IDs, exact 298.15/90.170 K, liquid phase, product 10 MPa and O/F=2.2..4.0. Failure keeps C output unchanged.
c_contract.supported_method_domain: Seven HP/frozen C/CEA points O/F=2.2,2.4,2.6,2.9,3.2,3.6,4.0 support bounded numerical method use; no phase-stability or whole-interval hardware certification.

missing_value_policy: No substitution of RP-1, dodecane or NIST thermophysical surrogate for an unidentified Chinese fuel batch.
